jobs.title: Service Engineer Laser
jobs.description:
Service Engineer Laser — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Biel/Bienne (BE).

Service Engineer Laser
Workload: 100%
Location: Biel or Geneva
Your tasks
- Installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of laser texturing and cutting machines
- Execution of retrofits, upgrades, and machine conversions
- Identification and implementation of optimization opportunities in close collaboration with Development and 2nd
Level Support
- Professional handling, troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation of service cases
- Support in creating, reviewing, and improving technical documentation and process procedures
- Occasional assistance with trade fair setup and dismantling activities
- Ensuring full compliance with Advanced Manufacturing safety standards, including particle emissions, laser
radiation, contamination control, gas handling, and explosion prevention
- Participation in additional functional responsibilities based on expertise and business requirements ( , internal
training, quality initiatives, or special technical projects — approximately 10% of working time)
Your profile
- Completed technical vocational training, ideally with an additional qualification as a certified technician
- Several years of experience as a Service Technician for laser machines or comparable high-tech industrial equipment
- Strong customer-service orientation combined with an independent and structured work approach
- High willingness to travel (up to 90%) across Europe and Switzerland
- Good MS Office skills and strong IT knowledge in hardware and software environments
- Fluent English skills are mandatory, along with fluent German or French
- High commitment to providing excellent customer support and service quality
- Reliable, responsible, and team-oriented personality
- Strong communication skills with a customer-focused mindset
- Independent, solution-oriented, goal-driven, and organized way of working
UNITED MACHINING is one of the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools
manufacturers and the mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining,
and additive manufacturing machines.
Learn more...
Great career opportunities: UNITED MACHINING provides many opportunities regarding career growth. We also offer a
dedicated talent management process (MyNextBigStep) to boost your career.
Excellent learning tools: At UNITED MACHINING we provide development opportunities for everyone. We offer global
learning tools as well as trainings and specialized courses.
Sustainability and innovation focus: We have high sustainability and innovation goals. Let's work towards a
sustainable future together.
About us
and additive manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized
solutions backed by unrivaled customer services and support.
UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R.
UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites
worldwide.

jobs.description:
Polymechaniker — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Biel (BE).

Polymechaniker (w/m/d)
Pensum: 80-100%
Arbeitsort: Biel
Anstellungsart: Unbefristet
## Ihre Aufgaben
- Aufbauen von Baugruppen und Maschinen nach Zeichnungen und Stücklisten
- Termingerechte Abwicklung der verlangten Produktionsmengen unter Berücksichtigung der Qualitätsrichtlinien und
- Einhaltung der Vorgabezeiten
- Unterhalt der Anlagen und Eirichtungen
## Ihr Profil
- Abgeschlossene Grundausbildung zum Polymechaniker EFZ oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Maschinen- oder Anlagebau oder in der Baugruppenmontage
- Grundwissen in Hydraulik und Pneumatik
- Kenntnisse der Steuerung Heidenhain sind wünschenswert
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
- MIKRON MILL ist einer der weltweiten Experten für vertikales Fräsen und Erfinder des Hochgeschwindigkeitsfräsens. Die
- automatisierungsfähigen Maschinen sind bekannt für dynamische Präzision und Freiformgenauigkeit und liefern
- Spitzenleistungen bei komplexen Anwendungen. MIKRON MILL steht für Innovation, Agilität und nachhaltigen Mehrwert.

- Ausgezeichnete Karrierechancen: UNITED MACHINING bietet viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung. Wir bieten einen
- Talentmanagementprozess (MyNextBigStep), um Ihre Karriere zu fördern.
- Ausgezeichnete Schulungsinstrumente: Bei UNITED MACHINING bieten wir Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für alle. Wir bieten

- gemeinsam auf eine nachhaltige Zukunft hinarbeiten.

- UNITED MACHINING ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Komplettlösungen für Hersteller von
- Präzisionskomponenten und Werkzeugen sowie für den Formenbau. Das Portfolio umfasst Maschinen für das Fräsen, die

- Geschäftsbereich Spindeln, Automatisierungslösungen, Werkzeuge und digitalisierte Lösungen, die durch einen
- unübertroffenen Kundenservice und Support unterstützt werden.
- Zu UNITED MACHINING gehören die Marken AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC und SYSTEM 3R.

assemblies returned from the field.

100%WorkloadMeyrinLocationUnlimitedJob type Apply now
Your tasks
- As a Modern Workplace Specialist – Messaging, Identity & Device Management, you will ensure the reliability,
security, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 workplace services. You will act as the technical expert for
messaging, identity, and endpoint management, driving automation, standardization, and service excellence across the
organization. Working closely with our managed-services partner, you will define best practices, oversee operational
quality, and provide advanced technical support for complex issues and projects. Through your expertise in Exchange
Online, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and PowerShell automation, you will help deliver a secure, scalable, and modern
digital workplace aligned with business and compliance requirements.
- Administer and optimize Microsoft Exchange Online, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Intune services.
- Design, implement, and maintain secure messaging, identity, access management, and endpoint management solutions.
- Manage mail flow, email security, Conditional Access, MFA, and endpoint compliance policies.
- Develop and maintain PowerShell-based automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
- Support identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.

relevant) //Identity: Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, hybrid synchronization, Conditional Access,

jobs.description:
Impiegato di produzione 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Losone (TI).

Impiegato di produzione
Le tue responsabilità
• Eseguire le operazioni di montaggio meccanico di macchine EDM e dei sottogruppi secondo le istruzioni di montaggio e i requisiti di qualità.
• Collaborare con i colleghi di linea e con il team di collaudo per garantire la continuità ed il miglioramento continuo.
• Segnalare eventuali non conformità, anomalie o problematiche tecniche al responsabile di riferimento.
Il tuo profilo
• Formazione tecnica in ambito meccanico (diploma meccanico, perito meccanico, o AFC polimeccanico).
• Esperienza di almeno 1--2 anni in un ruolo di montaggio in ambiente manifatturiero.
• Capacità di lettura di disegni tecnici e utilizzo di strumenti di misura di base. La patente muletto frontale e carroponte costituiscono un plus.
• Approccio preciso, metodico e orientato alla qualità; buona attitudine al lavoro in team.
• Italiano madrelingua o livello C1.
Su di noi
AGIE CHARMILLES, inventore della tecnologia EDM (elettroerosione), è riconosciuto come marchio di eccellenza e leader nell'innovazione nel campo dell'elettroerosione a filo, a tuffo e di foratura. Le sue soluzioni predisposte per l'automazione trovano impiego nella costruzione di stampi e nella produzione di componenti di alta gamma, garantendo la precisione, l'affidabilità e le prestazioni degne della tradizione svizzera
UNITED MACHINING è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di soluzioni complete per i produttori di componenti e utensili di precisione e per il settore della costruzione di stampi. Il portafoglio comprende macchine per fresatura, elettroerosione, texturizzazione laser, microlavorazione laser e produzione additiva. Inoltre, la divisione offre mandrini, automazione, utensili e soluzioni digitalizzate, supportate da un servizio clienti e un'assistenza senza pari.
UNITED MACHINING comprende i marchi AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC e SYSTEM 3R.
UNITED MACHINING ha sede a Biel, in Svizzera, e conta attualmente oltre 3.000 dipendenti in più di 50 sedi in tutto il mondo.

Production employee
Your responsibilities
• Perform mechanical assembly operations of EDM machines and subgroups according to assembly instructions and quality requirements.
• Collaborate with line colleagues and the testing team to ensure continuity and continuous improvement.
• Report any non-compliance, anomalies or technical issues to the reference manager.
Your profile
• Technical training in mechanical engineering (mechanical diploma, mechanical expert, or polymechanical AFC).
• Experience of at least 1--2 years in a mounting role in the manufacturing environment.
• Ability to read technical drawings and use basic measuring instruments. The front mule driver's license is a plus.
• Precise, methodical and quality oriented approach; good team work attitude.
• Italian native speakers or level C1.
About us
AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM technology (electrohesion), is recognized as a brand of excellence and leader in innovation in the field of wire, dip and drilling electroerosion. Its automation solutions are used in the construction of moulds and in the production of high-end components, ensuring the precision, reliability and performance worthy of the Swiss tradition
UNITED MACHINING is one of the world's leading suppliers of complete solutions for manufacturers of precision components and tools and for the mold construction industry. The portfolio includes milling, electro-erosion, laser texturization, laser micro-processing and additive manufacturing. In addition, the division offers spindles, automation, tools and digitalized solutions, supported by a customer service and unparalleled assistance.
UNITED MACHINING includes AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R.
UNITED MACHINING is based in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has over 3,000 employees in more than 50 locations worldwide.

Employé de production
Vos responsabilités
• Effectuer les opérations d'assemblage mécanique des machines et sous-groupes EDM selon les instructions d'assemblage et les exigences de qualité.
• Collaborer avec les collègues et l'équipe d'essais pour assurer la continuité et l'amélioration continue.
• Signaler toute non-conformité, anomalies ou problèmes techniques au gestionnaire des références.
Votre profil
• Formation technique en génie mécanique (diplôme mécanique, expert en mécanique ou AFC polymécanique).
• Expérience d'au moins 1-2 ans dans un rôle croissant dans l'environnement de fabrication.
• Capacité de lire des dessins techniques et d'utiliser des instruments de mesure de base. Le permis de conduire de mule avant est un plus.
• Approche précise, méthodique et axée sur la qualité; bonne attitude de travail en équipe.
• Locuteurs natifs italiens ou niveau C1.
À propos de nous
AGIE CHARMILLES, inventeur de la technologie EDM (électrolyse), est reconnue comme une marque d'excellence et leader dans l'innovation dans le domaine de l'électroérosion par fil, trempe et forage. Ses solutions d'automatisation sont utilisées dans la construction de moules et dans la production de composants haut de gamme, assurant la précision, la fiabilité et les performances dignes de la tradition suisse.
UNITED MACHINING est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de solutions complètes pour les fabricants de composants et d'outils de précision et pour l'industrie de la construction de moules. La gamme comprend le fraisage, l'électro-érosion, la texturisation au laser, le micro-traitement au laser et la fabrication additive. En outre, la division propose des broches, de l'automatisation, des outils et des solutions numérisées, soutenues par un service client et une assistance inégalée.
Le MACHINAGE UNI comprend AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC et SYSTEM 3R.
UNITED MACHINING est basé à Biel, en Suisse, et compte actuellement plus de 3 000 employés dans plus de 50 endroits dans le monde.
